source: Static analysis of frontend/lib (home_screen.dart _screens + sidebar, navigation_provider.dart, command_palette_registry.dart), backend modules/*/router.py, doc.md and docs/phase_*.md

run_target.platform: Flutter web release build (http://127.0.0.1:8088) — Windows desktop not buildable (Visual Studio missing)

navigation_notes: Navigation is not GoRouter: HomeScreen keeps an IndexedStack of 70 slots (indices 0-69) and selectNavigationIndex(ref, i) switches slot + opens a workspace tab.

Sidebar hubs (ExpansionTile) are collapsed by default: click the parent_menu title first, or type part of the label in the sidebar quick-search box ("بحث سريع..." / "Quick Search..."), which auto-expands matching hubs.

Sidebar labels come from localeProvider (Arabic when locale=ar, English otherwise). Default locale is EN until toggled: click the header icon with tooltip "Switch Language (AR / EN)" / "تغيير اللغة (عربي / إنجليزي)". The choice is persisted via flutter_secure_storage.

KNOWN ISSUE (record, do not fix): main.dart sets MaterialApp.locale = ar without supportedLocales, so Localizations.localeOf resolves to en_US; Material widgets (date pickers, default tooltips, etc.) stay English even in Arabic mode. context.l10n strings follow localeProvider through the custom AppLocalizationsProvider and are Arabic.

BUG: _totalScreens = 68 in core/providers/navigation_provider.dart, so sidebar indices 68 (Shipment Inquiry) and 69 (System Observability) are silently ignored. 68 is reachable via Ctrl+K command palette; 69 is unreachable.
Tab labels listed per screen are Arabic/English pairs resolved from app_localizations_ar/en.dart or inline isArabic ternaries.
Code numbering conflict: doc.md and docs/phase_*.md disagree from BP-014 onward (e.g. ACID = BP-014 in phase_03 vs BP-015 in doc.md). Codes here follow docs/phase_*.md for BP and doc.md for MD.
